title: States
description: The named variables pal reads: the ones you declare in `[states]`, the built-ins (the hour, the weekday, the front app, the network), what extensions publish. Set one by hand for a while, reset it, declare a new one; a bar item shows what is being held by hand.
author: pal

Set true or false until reset, or for 15 minutes, an hour, three hours, until tomorrow; any value and duration typed into the row
New state writes `[states.<name>]` to the config file with an expression, a default and a description
A bar item that shows only while a state is held by hand, with the time left
